result: Implemented focusa.mission_canvas.layout_memory.update as a bounded generated mutation. Core validates exact Workstream authority and semantic placement memory, persists the update with Evidence and a direct RecompositionReceipt atomically, and makes retries idempotent. The API adapter enforces generated permission, actor/authority, Idempotency-Key, and If-Match boundaries. Desktop uses the generated operation registry/client and rejects foreign, stale, malformed, or locally composed results.

OPS-009.decision: The exact Workstream-scoped layout-memory read, generated registry transport, reusable Core validator, and fail-closed memory watermark from OPS-009 are integrated and preserved.

presentation_contract.surface_kind: bounded Focusa Desktop Mission Canvas Svelte generated-operation consumer; the trusted recursive canonical projection renderer remains unchanged
presentation_contract.proof_class: generated transport/runtime integration with Core atomic persistence, exact Workstream authority, Receipt/Evidence proof, and hostile response checks
omitted_contribution_reasons: layout_memory.update persists semantic preference and does not render contributions
absent contribution IDs remain memory data and never reserve geometry, placeholders, borders, or empty chrome
continuity_invariants: ScopeRef -> ProjectRootKey -> WorkstreamId -> ContinuityId -> AttachmentKey -> SessionId/InstanceId -> WorkspaceBindingId -> RuntimeObjectRef -> WorkSurfaceId remains exact and immutable.
Core owns identity, validation, revision, persistence, Evidence, Receipt, and idempotency; Desktop does not infer eligibility or compose a layout.
Generated registry/OpenAPI/client/validator artifacts remain authoritative for operation metadata and DTOs; no generated artifact was edited.
The trusted recursive canonical projection renderer and CARDINAL-135-SVELTE-001 boundary remain untouched.

generated_contract.artifact_status: Generated operation registry, OpenAPI, TypeScript client, validators, and parity artifacts were consumed without modification.

implementation: ProfileLayoutMemory and PlacementMemory reject unknown fields; Core validates exact full scope equality, canonical memory identity, RFC3339 timestamp, idempotency metadata, ContributionId/RegionKind values, spans, duplicates, placement/absent overlap, and revision advancement.
LayoutMemoryUpdateService checks WorkstreamContext, permission, If-Match-derived expected revision, and payload revision without resolving eligibility or composing a layout.

MissionCanvasStore::update_layout_memory performs the memory row, layout_changed event, Evidence, Receipt cursor update, request digest, authority reference, and idempotency record in one SQLite transaction. A matching Workstream-scoped causation key and request digest returns the original Receipt; conflicting retries and stale revisions fail closed.

The API route accepts the generated ProfileLayoutMemory rather than DocumentWriteRequest, requires exact actor/authority context, mission_canvas:write, matching Idempotency-Key, and If-Match, then returns the direct Core RecompositionReceipt.

Desktop resolves the generated operation ID/method/path, sends exact authority plus Idempotency-Key and If-Match, validates request memory and direct Receipt proof, and maintains per-authority/profile/activity/viewport revision and event-cursor watermarks.

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: Desktop rejects a Receipt whose Workstream differs; Core/API scope and Attachment ownership checks reject foreign authority and storage remains Workstream-partitioned.
negative_cases.foreign_attachment_or_subordinate_scope: Desktop compares the complete authority context, including Attachment, continuity, binding, runtime object, and Work Surface; the API extracts the same exact context and does not infer missing ownership.
negative_cases.missing_authority: Generated Desktop input, actor/authority headers, and Core WorkstreamContext validation all fail before mutation when exact authority is absent.
negative_cases.stale_revision: If-Match is required and bound to the memory revision; Core compares the stored row and expected advancement, while Desktop rejects a structurally valid regressed Receipt watermark.
negative_cases.stale_cursor: Desktop parses the direct Receipt event cursor and rejects a lower same-kind event cursor for the same exact memory binding.
negative_cases.wrong_receipt_revision: Desktop rejects an accepted Receipt whose projection/layout revision is not exactly the If-Match revision plus one or whose projection and layout revisions disagree.
negative_cases.idempotency: Blank/mismatched keys fail before persistence; Core binds causation to the Workstream and request digest, returns the original Receipt on an exact retry, and rejects conflicting reuse.
negative_cases.malformed_or_wrapped_response: Generated structural validation plus nested memory/Receipt proof validation rejects malformed placements, partition overlap, invalid proof, wrappers, and non-accepted receipts.
negative_cases.permission_or_capability: The operation requires mission_canvas:write; Desktop sends no invented capability and surfaces denied/unavailable ToolResult responses without fallback mutation.
negative_cases.empty_or_ineligible_contribution: Absent contribution IDs are persisted as semantic memory only; no eligibility, panel, renderer, placeholder, or geometry is fabricated.
negative_cases.local_inference: The hostile consumer asserts that request/response data contains no layout_tree, eligible contribution projection, persistence envelope, or local composition path.

acceptance.statement: Persists semantic placement preference with idempotency and Receipt.
acceptance.proof: Core owns the bounded mutation and atomic SQLite event/Receipt/Evidence write; the generated operation contract and hostile consumer verify POST transport, Idempotency-Key, If-Match, direct RecompositionReceipt, retry/conflict boundaries, and no local composition.

acceptance.statement: Preserves CARDINAL-135-SVELTE-001, exact Workstream authority, generated transport, trusted renderer ownership, and recursive canonical projection rendering.
acceptance.proof: Generated parity and the operation contract pass; generated contract artifacts and the canonical projection renderer were not edited or bypassed, and the consumer rejects foreign authority rather than falling back.
